## Team News

Gaziantep are expected to be without Fuat Bavuk, who is dealing with a hamstring injury, and Nazim Sangare, who has a back problem.

Serdar Dursun, Sontje Hansen, Arda Kizildag, Ulrich Meleke and Oguz Ozcecik are also listed as doubts, although their availability will need to be assessed closer to kickoff. [...] Amed SK possible starting lineup:

Lafont; Krasniqi, Yesil, Bates, Meras; Raveloson, Soyalp; Lutin, Saba, Sor; Orban

## We say: Gaziantep 1-2 Amed SK

Gaziantep's poor run of results and inability to win at home make it difficult to back them to turn things around against an Amed SK side that has shown considerably more attacking quality throughout the campaign.

The visitors look better equipped to secure all three points, and a narrow away victory appears the most likely outcome.

data.content:
14

Gaziantep F.K. host Amed SK on November 28 in round 13 of the Turkish Super Lig. Kick-off is scheduled for 16:00 local time at Gaziantep Stadyumu. This will be the first meeting between the clubs, and they arrive in contrasting positions: Gaziantep are 16th, while Amed are fourth. The hosts have won only twice in 12 league matches and are looking to halt a difficult run. Amed have lost their last two games, but their seven wins this season underline why this is a test for Gaziantep. [...] Gaziantep F.K. enter the fixture after a 1-0 defeat to Gençlerbirliği on November 21. They have taken one win from their last five matches, losing the other four. Across that stretch, they have averaged 1.0 goals scored and 1.6 conceded per game. Their broader Super Lig record is two wins, two draws and eight defeats, with season averages of 0.8 goals scored and 1.7 allowed. [...] The season records give Amed SK the stronger foundation: seven league wins to Gaziantep’s two, a higher scoring average and a fourth-place standing against 16th. Gaziantep’s recent half-time deficits add to the challenge, though Amed’s two straight losses mean the visitors cannot take a turnaround for granted. With no previous head-to-head result to draw on, recent form and the supplied league statistics provide the clearest guide to this Super Lig preview.
